name: Blade Master
summary: Blade Master - Mini Action RPG is a fast-paced arcade action-RPG where players guide a hero armed with an arsenal of orbiting, spinning blades. Navigate through monster-infested arenas, dodge relentless enemy attacks, and slice through waves of mobs and giant bosses. Featuring rogue-lite progression, players can unlock multiple distinct heroes, upgrade stats, and discover dozens of unique blade combinations and tactical abilities across hundreds of challenging stages.
